page_title: Multi Player TicTacToe Game App using Flutter, Node, Express and Socket - Full Stack Development

summary.title: Multi Player TicTacToe Game App using Flutter, Node, Express and Socket - Full Stack Development
summary.one_liner: You learn how to build a two-player online tic-tac-toe game with a Flutter client and a Node.js/Express server that uses Socket.io for real-time play and MongoDB for storage.
keywords: how to make a realtime game with flutter and node
takeaways: Set up a Flutter project with create room and join room screens.
Build a Node.js and Express server connected to MongoDB via Mongoose.
Use Socket.io to create and join game rooms and sync moves in real time.
Add Provider state management, a waiting lobby, scoreboard, and turn-based board logic.
Implement round and game winner checks, clearing the board, and ending the game.
summary.summary: This is a long video tutorial (about 3h20m) by Rivaan Ranawat that walks through building an online two-player tic-tac-toe game. The video starts with a demo and Flutter project setup, then builds the UI for creating and joining rooms. It moves on to a Node.js and Express server, connects it to MongoDB, and wires up Socket.io for room creation, joining, and live moves. The later chapters cover Provider state management, a waiting lobby, a scoreboard, turn handling, round and game winner checks, and the end-game flow. The page description calls it beginner-friendly.
